months_late.note: ASSUMPTION. Same method as the example (planned home sales complete Jun 2025 per grant Exhibit B schedule, PDF p.40, to scheduled construction completion), updated with the newest city schedule: completion of all six homes Oct 2026 (FY2026-27 Q1 report, Exhibit 2). Jun 2025 to Oct 2026 = 16 months. The example used 11 (May 2026 completion from the FY2025-26 Q1 report).

contingency_remaining.note: Budget contingency was $477,762 (grant Exhibit C, PDF p.41, verified by Hassan); amount left is not public

city_holdback.note: Still committed and not expended as of Sept 30, 2026. $1,980,000 of the $2,200,000 grant has been expended (Table 8).

source.doc: Santa Ana Housing Division Quarterly Report FY2026-27 Q1
source.locator: Table 9 (PDF p.8); Available Funds, PDF p.12 ('1921 W. Washington Project Pre-Commitment')

holdback_release_condition.value: Construction complete; certificate of occupancy issued; homebuyers have signed the City loan documents and closed escrow; lien-free (35 days after a recorded Notice of Completion, or 95 days after actual completion, with no liens outstanding)
holdback_release_condition.note: Read by Hassan in the agreement (PDF p.8). Sec. 4.3: once conditions are met, the City disburses within 21 days. The team example left out the lien-free condition.

source.doc: Conditional Grant Agreement (Exhibit 2 to Item 12, Santa Ana City Council, July 16, 2024)

months_until_release.note: ASSUMPTION carried over from the example. The newest city schedule lists 'New first-time homeowner families move in' and 'Project Complete' in Nov 2026 (FY2026-27 Q1, Exhibit 2), which suggests release could be sooner, but the holdback was unpaid at Sept 30, 2026 and the closing dates are not public. Floor from the grant agreement: release needs a recorded Notice of Completion plus 35 lien-free days (or 95 days after completion), then up to 21 days to pay (Sec. 4.2(d), 4.3).
